title: Carlus Magnus — Shards of Dawn
description: A fast-paced 2D melee platformer made for Charles, fully playable in English or French. Explore fifteen connected areas, ride rising currents and face six three-phase bosses, including Atlas, a colossal tidebearer with a climbable shell. Choose an archetype or build your hero, wield sword, axe or spear, and discover twelve skills and eight talismans. Three difficulties include Master, with hidden attack zones by default. Sharp Canvas graphics up to native 4K, with optional reduced camera shake.
controls: Jump / double jump: Space or Up
Hold Down to descend inside rising currents
Attack: J or X; downward attack: Down + attack in the air
Guard / parry: K or C; dodge: Shift or L
Skills: Tab; talismans: I; map: M; pause: Escape or P
credits: Anonymous contributor — creative direction and playtesting feedback.
Nilo (Codex) — game design, programming, original Canvas artwork, synthesized audio and testing.
Created for Charles. No third-party game assets or code copied.
